# Republic Map

<Story name="Base" id="components-republicmap--map" />

```html
<SRepublicMap />
```

- If you want to add Map shadow, please import the **image** below to your assets directory

```html
<img
  :class="$props.dynamicClassShadow"
  alt="republic chart"
  class="absolute block max-w-[628.58px] max-h-[283.55px] w-full top-0.5 left-0 -z-1"
  src="../../assets/images/republic.png"
/>
```

## Plugins

- To use v-tooltip, please install the package ** Floating vue **
  [Floating Vue](https://floating-vue.starpad.dev/)

```html
npm i -S floating-vue
```

or

```html
yarn add floating-vue
```

- Install the plugin into Vue:

```html
import FloatingVue from 'floating-vue' app.use(FloatingVue)
```

- Or use the directives and components directly:

```html
import { // Directives VTooltip, VClosePopper, // Components Dropdown, Tooltip,
Menu } from 'floating-vue' app.directive('tooltip', VTooltip)
app.directive('close-popper', VClosePopper) app.component('VDropdown', Dropdown)
app.component('VTooltip', Tooltip) app.component('VMenu', Menu)
```

- Add the default CSS:

```html
import 'floating-vue/dist/style.css'
```
